name: Progress Tube Master pipe-laying robot
summary: Robot for precast plants that bends heating and cooling pipes and lays them on the pallet on top of the reinforcement for slabs with activated concrete cores, replacing manual pipe laying. Developed by Progress Maschinen & Automation and first installed at Mischek Systembau near Vienna.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Progress Group from Brixen (Italy, EU). No price published and no German installation found; the first unit runs in Austria. The maker's product pages beyond the shuttering robot returned 403 to the polite reader.

sellers.name: Progress Maschinen & Automation AG
sellers.note: Julius-Durst-Straße 100, I-39042 Brixen, Italy. Price on request.

specs.label: Task
specs.value: bending and laying heating and cooling pipes for activated concrete cores
specs.quote: bending and laying pipes for precast concrete elements with activated concrete core

specs.label: Laying position
specs.value: directly on top of the inserted reinforcement
specs.quote: The system is capable of laying pipes directly on top of the previously inserted reinforcement and replaces tedious manual work

specs.label: Daily output
specs.conditions: up to; 3-shift operation at Mischek Systembau
specs.quote: The Tube Master is currently running a 3-shift operation from Sunday, 10 pm, to Friday, 10 pm, with a daily output of up to 300 m².

notes: Works in a pallet circulation plant; it was fitted into an existing line for semi-finished precast components while production continued.
Pipes still need fastening on the pallet after laying (minimum rework, per the article).
Robot type (gantry or arm), pipe diameters and speed are not given in the text read.
